definitions.explanation: An area of grass that is kept mowed, typically in a garden or park.

examples.japanese: {芝生|しばふ}の{上|うえ}で{子|こ}どもたちが{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: Children are playing on the lawn.

examples.japanese: {芝生|しばふ}に{入|はい}らないでください。
{週末|しゅうまつ}に{芝生|しばふ}を{刈|か}った。{天気|てんき}が{良|よ}かったので、{芝刈|しばか}り{後|ご}に{庭|にわ}でお{茶|ちゃ}を{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: I mowed the lawn on the weekend. Since the weather was nice, I had tea in the garden after mowing.

notes:
{芝生|しばふ} refers to a lawn or grassed area, typically maintained (mowed).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {芝生|しばふ}を{刈|か}る (to mow the lawn)
- {芝生|しばふ}に{寝転|ねころ}ぶ (to lie on the grass)
- {芝生|しばふ}の{手入|てい}れ (lawn maintenance)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芝生|しばふ}{広場|ひろば} (grassy plaza/square)
- {人工|じんこう}{芝|しば} (artificial turf)
- {芝刈|しばか}り{機|き} (lawn mower)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {芝生|しばふ}: lawn, maintained grass area
- {草|くさ}: grass (general, uncut)
- {芝|しば}: turf, lawn grass (the plant itself)
